ModMetaData.name: Colony Epitaph
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces the underwhelming Game Over letter with a full-screen epitaph when the colony is wiped.
The map dims, the game pauses, and you get the colony name, how long it lasted, and portraits of the fallen — with the same continue, wanderers, load, and main-menu choices vanilla already offers.
Victory credits, the planetkiller fade, and Man in Black are left alone. A setting restores the vanilla letter if you want it back.
